ruleset_name: Universal Deterministic AOP Mapper Ruleset v1
contract: Template masks define geometry; AI/CV ranks artwork content; deterministic rules constrain mapping and validate output.

universal_rules.rule: Protected focal content cannot be placed in seam/blur/bleed/fold/hem/cuff/collar/placket/zipper/pocket/crotch/panel-boundary risk zones.
Fill the entire full-bleed production shape; no blank bleed.
Faces, eyes, readable text, logos, and hero features must fit inside safe print area.
A focal can span panels only if adjacent panels complete it cleanly and no protected feature is cut by the join.
Overlay pockets must use exact underlying source art region; random similar crop fails.
Back panels default to supporting continuation; no random duplicate people.
If assembled garment looks chopped, amputated, or accidental, reject and retry.
